relationships.subject: Gastrodin
relationships.evidence_quote: IT administration of GAS significantly attenuated the expression of NLRP3 inflammasome and the intensity of SNL-induced mechanical allodynia.

relationships.subject: Gastrodin
relationships.evidence_quote: IT gastrodin abolishes the increase in the expression of NLRP3 inflammasome components including NLRP3, ASC, and caspase-1, resulting in the blockade of IL-1β production.

relationships.subject: Spinal nerve ligation
relationships.evidence_quote: The protein and mRNA levels of NLRP3, apoptosis-associated speck-like protein containing a caspase recruitment domain (ASC), caspase-1, and IL-1β were upregulated in SNL animals compared to Sham animals.

relationships.subject: MCC950
relationships.evidence_quote: NLRP3 inflammasome inhibitor, MCC950, also attenuated the intensity of allodynia, but the effect is less strong and shorter than that of GAS.

key_findings: NLRP3, ASC, caspase-1 and IL-1β rise in spinal cord and DRG after SNL, mostly in neurons.
Intrathecal gastrodin reversed this and gave a stronger, longer anti-allodynic effect than MCC950.
